decisions.reason: As a facial care line close to the firm’s core natural skincare know-how and still given its own page in 2024, it fits existing capabilities well and offers good scope for incremental learning and refinement.

The hyaluronic acid serum is also close to the established offer and remained on the website across both years, so despite somewhat less prominent presentation it is still likely to be retained because the firm can interpret demand and improve it within its existing knowledge base.

The cleansing oil is near the firm’s existing product domain, but as the newest launch with only a 2024 mention and no longer track record, it carries more uncertainty even though the firm’s in-house development and production capabilities support continued testing and adjustment.
